title: Stop using abbreviations
body:
### What feature would you like to see?

The GPT-5 model is consistently using abbreviations in code, which makes the code unreadable. Please instruct it in the default prompt not to do this - it's a very bad (and annoying) coding practice.

### Are you interested in implementing this feature?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves prompt management problems, as it requests changes to the default prompt to alter the behavior of the LLM (GPT-5 model) in generating code without abbreviations. This aligns with prompt-related issues in agent systems.
